original:
Theorem 3.

Let $G$ be a connected graph with $m$ edges and $n$ vertices. If $G$ is

(c) 

loopless and bridgeless with either $m\leq 1.21(n-1)$ or $m\geq 5.62(n-1),$ then

 ${T_{G}(1,1)}^{2}\leq T_{G}(2,0)T_{G}(0,2).$

attempts.note: No counterexample found in small eligible multigraphs or cycles. Saved reduction.lean and reduction_notes.txt in forge/data/staging/agents/queue-papers-b1/queue-papers-b1-w8. The complete two-hole skeleton passes local Lean checking in test_light2.lean using narrow imports and verbatim copies of the three library definitions; all nine helpers and the final combination compile. Exact admissible parameter pairs are (7427/10000,23741/20000) and (461/100,561/200), with sparse power comparison 17/14 and dense comparison 73/13, giving the required 1.21 and 5.62 thresholds without logarithms. Remaining holes are the general cross-multiplied loopless bound (same as existing x2611_15008_thm3_a_s1h1) and its bridgeless analogue. Official forge sketch failed twice before checking the body because Mathlib2/Shard/S0061.olean is missing; no sketch or children registered. Main theorem remains unproved.
